Google CEO Details AI Applications in Health, Weather, and Education

Google CEO Sundar Pichai has outlined the technology giant's advancements in artificial intelligence, highlighting its potential applications across various sectors including health, weather forecasting, and education. Pichai stated that these AI developments can accelerate scientific research. However, he also cautioned that realizing these benefits is not guaranteed and requires a collective effort.
